thesis_statement: Vertiv makes the power, thermal management and liquid-cooling equipment that high-density AI data centers need; it is growing sales more than 20% with expanding margins and has raised full-year guidance, but it is a high-multiple, cycle-exposed pure play.

base.summary: Organic growth near 30% for 2026 with adjusted operating margin in the low 20s, in line with raised guidance.
drivers: AI data-center thermal and power demand

bull.summary: Liquid cooling becomes standard for AI racks and Vertiv takes share, beating guidance.

bear.summary: Data-center capex slows or supply-chain problems delay projects, and the high multiple compresses sharply.

key_risks: Valuation: trailing P/E ~57, forward ~28, price-to-book ~20; a guidance cut would hit the stock hard.
Execution: Q2 revenue saw timing shifts from supply-chain congestion and multi-phase project execution.
Overlaps with ETN (both data-center power), so their signals are not independent.

invalidation_reasons.price: Close below the live guarded-SQL reference_invalidation_level (207.80 at the 2026-09-26 renewal). SQL governs after any later renewal; this text does not.
fundamental: Full-year sales or adjusted EPS guidance is cut.
Adjusted operating margin falls below 19% for two consecutive quarters.
